// Generated companion for a private P02 adaptation. No app-kit runtime required.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// templ's control-flow whitespace rules differ from its component-body rules.
// A Go loop renders the typed item and its exact source separator explicitly.
func pricingFeatures(features []string) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		for i, feature := range features {
			if err := pricingFeature(feature).Render(ctx, w); err != nil { return err }
			if i < len(features)-1 {
				if _, err := io.WriteString(w, pricingFeatureSeparator); err != nil { return err }
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
}

// Pricing contains presentation copy, not billing authority. Price and currency
// are app-formatted text; this component neither computes nor collects payment.
type Pricing struct {
	Heading, Introduction, Plan, Description, Included string
	Features []string
	Payment, Price, Currency, Action, Note, URL string
}

// NewPricingEnhanced opts into the companion pricing.css containment and 44px
// CTA rules. Callers must include that stylesheet, after source CSS. NewPricing
// remains the separately available source-faithful representation.
func NewPricingEnhanced(data Pricing) (templ.Component, error) {
	content, err := NewPricing(data)
	if err != nil { return nil, err }
	return pricingEnhanced(content), nil
}

// NewPricing validates before producing any HTML and snapshots mutable input.
// One native same-window link is the only action. Its destination and any
// authentication, checkout, tax or availability semantics belong to the app.
func NewPricing(data Pricing) (templ.Component, error) {
	for _, field := range []struct { name, value string; max int }{
		{"Heading", data.Heading, 160}, {"Introduction", data.Introduction, 1200},
		{"Plan", data.Plan, 160}, {"Description", data.Description, 1200},
		{"Included", data.Included, 100}, {"Payment", data.Payment, 160},
		{"Price", data.Price, 64}, {"Currency", data.Currency, 16},
		{"Action", data.Action, 100}, {"Note", data.Note, 400},
	} {
		if !pricingText(field.value, field.max) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("pricing: invalid %s", field.name) }
	}
	if len(data.Features) < 1 || len(data.Features) > 12 { return nil, fmt.Errorf("pricing: feature count must be 1..12") }
	for _, feature := range data.Features {
		if !pricingText(feature, 240) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("pricing: invalid feature") }
	}
	if !pricingURL(data.URL) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("pricing: destination must be a local absolute path or HTTPS URL") }
	data.Features = append([]string(nil), data.Features...)
	return pricing(data), nil
}

func pricingText(s string, limit int) bool {
	if len(s) > limit || strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(s) { return false }
	for _, r := range s { if unicode.IsControl(r) { return false } }
	return true
}

func pricingURL(s string) bool {
	if !pricingText(s, 2048) || strings.TrimSpace(s) != s || strings.ContainsAny(s, "\\ ") { return false }
	u, err := url.Parse(s)
	if err != nil || u.User != nil || u.Opaque != "" { return false }
	// Refuse encoded control characters/backslashes too, before browser URL
	// normalization or a consumer's redirect handler can interpret them.
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(s)
	if err != nil || !pricingText(decoded, 2048) || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") { return false }
	if strings.HasPrefix(s, "/") {
		return !strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == ""
	}
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
		if err != nil || n == 0 { return false }
	}
	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "https://") && u.Scheme == "https" && u.Hostname() != "" && !strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") && u.Fragment == "" && !strings.ContainsAny(u.Host, "% ")
}
